resourcePourProvenance: Built-in imagegen edits on 2026-10-02 of the existing four-frame 2x2 gold-pour sheet. Each gemstone family replaces round nuggets with its own faceted particle shape and color while retaining the four falling-stream poses. Raw 1254x1254 transparent sources are retained as pour-source.png per site. assets/source/sites/normalize_pours.py downsamples each cell independently to 128x128 and exports a 256x256 transparent sheet. Browser switching and native-scale site captures verify the active resource texture and visible animation states.
miningImpactProvenance: Built-in imagegen edits on 2026-10-02 of the existing four-frame 2x2 Forge mining-impact sheet. Five gemstone families retain the small-to-large-to-fading burst timing but replace gold fragments with resource-colored crystal facets. Raw transparent sources are impact-source.png per site. assets/source/sites/normalize_impacts.py exports a 256x256 2x2 RGBA sheet. Browser switching and native-scale site captures verify the active resource texture and visible strike states.
shaftProvenance: Built-in imagegen edits on 2026-10-02 of public/assets/step-32a/elevator-shaft.png, retaining the rails and vertical brace rhythm. Original opaque portrait candidates retained under assets/source/sites/<site>/shaft-source.png. assets/source/sites/normalize_shafts.py exports RGB 192x528 native TileSprite textures with Pillow LANCZOS. Native-scale upper, middle and deep captures verify continuous repetition through the full 15-floor shaft.
cartProvenance: Built-in imagegen edits on 2026-10-02 using public/assets/step-32a/gold-container-filled.png as chassis/layout reference. Each site's raw RGBA cart-filled-source.png is retained under assets/source/sites/<site>/. assets/source/sites/normalize_cargo.py aligns alpha bounds to the Gold loaded cart at 256x256. The default empty wood cart remains shared.
marketplaceVehicleResourceOverlay: Marketplace miner vehicles keep their character and chassis sprites. Runtime composes the active site's ore-pile or pour sheet over the shared empty/load/deposit poses, so Boru, Tobi and Rivet carry the correct resource without duplicating full character sheets. Amethyst travel-loaded and Ruby deposit states are verified in browser tests.
offlineClaimIdentity: The offline reward modal reuses the selected site's 64x64 landmark, resource color and mine/resource name. This keeps claim identity consistent with Map and avoids a separate duplicate claim-art family.
paidCartProvenance: Built-in imagegen edits on 2026-10-02 of Tobi and Rivet loaded-cart sprites, preserving each vehicle form while replacing gold with the resource. Raw RGBA candidates retained as tobi-cart-filled-source.png and rivet-cart-filled-source.png per site. assets/source/sites/normalize_paid_carts.py aligns them to the original 128x128 Tobi [10,32,117,95] and Rivet [10,38,117,89] alpha bounds. Empty paid vehicles remain shared; runtime texture binding is covered by the site-art contract.
structureProvenance: Built-in imagegen edits on 2026-10-02 using the existing elevator-tower-v2.png and warehouse-building.png as geometry/style references. Each of five sites has full and empty tower states plus a resource-specific warehouse. Original RGBA candidates retained as *-source.png under assets/source/sites/<site>/. assets/source/sites/normalize_structures.py uses a shared full/empty crop, aligns both to the Gold tower alpha bounds, and aligns each warehouse to the Gold warehouse bounds at 512x512. All-site native-scale captures verify the runtime anchors and empty/loaded texture binding.
surfaceProvenance: Built-in imagegen edits on 2026-10-02 using public/assets/step-32a/surface-landscape-v1.png as the visual and layout reference. Chosen original 1859x846 PNGs are retained as surface-source.png per site. assets/source/sites/normalize_surface.py exports 720x328 RGB WebP quality 88 with Pillow LANCZOS. All five surfaces were reviewed at the native 360x640 viewport.
provenance: Generated with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-10-01. Upper floors use public/assets/step-32a/mine-floor-background.png as the layout and style reference; middle floors use their own upper asset as edit reference; deep floors use their own middle asset. Sources retained under assets/source/sites/. Final assets were resized to 576x264 with Pillow LANCZOS and reviewed in native-scale captures at floors 1, 5, 10 and 15.

map.landmarkProvenance: Hand-authored SVG silhouettes on 2026-10-02: nugget, geode, basalt shard, grotto, ruin/prism and icy peak. Each is 64x64, decorative inside labeled 44px-or-larger site buttons and selected-site details.
map.provenance: Built-in imagegen on 2026-10-01, using public/assets/step-32a/surface-landscape-v1.png as style reference. Prompt: top-down portrait cartoon terrain with six vertical geological regions (gold hills, violet geodes, red basalt, blue grotto, green forest ruins, snowy granite), no text, markers, paths, UI or characters. Pillow LANCZOS resize, WebP quality 82.
